signal: Strictly positive current minus prior-year same-month national all-age urban surveyed unemployment rate; tie/countercondition cash. First session strictly after actual declared release day. Multi-month releases use latest month. No parameter search.
source_exception: Retained2026 official-page values are assumed equal to their declared historical release values; actual retrieval timestamps preserved. Absence of silent revisions and full definition stability are unverified. Later-amended planned release schedules check corpus completeness only, never shift or prove historical availability.

statistics.primary: D=sum((z-z_bar)*log(1+y))/sum(n), where n is each open-to-open interval's exchange-session transitions and z_bar=sum(n*z)/sum(n). Units are gross log return per exchange session; matched-exposure comparator is descriptive.
statistics.selected: Report all selected interval counts, mean gross interval return, gross positive-interval frequency, exposure sessions, signal switches and annual contributions. Intervals and switches are not completed account trades.
statistics.bootstrap: 5000 paired circular block resamples of whole (z,y,n) release intervals, fixed block length12 and seed20260921; recompute weighted exposure and D each time; report2.5th/97.5th percentiles. Long blocks address persistent annual-contrast states but only about four blocks are available, and coverage is not certified.
statistics.qualification: At least6 selected intervals overall and3 in fixed2023onward slice, at least one unselected interval overall, full D2.5th percentile>0, full and later selected arithmetic mean gross returns>0, later D>0. Counts6/3 retain the preceding flow screen's minimum evidence convention, not a theorem about sufficient independent samples.
statistics.no_rescue: No sign, threshold, comparator, horizon, later split, block length, sample expansion or fee-case tuning after this run.
statistics.preregistration_limit: Economic formula and source window were fixed before historical corpus expansion. Raw macro levels have now been inspected for source quality; statistical contract is fixed before computed states and this new ETF-outcome join. This is conditional exploration, not an untouched preregistered confirmatory experiment.
